name: 莫嘎
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3241
who: Moga, a half-orc woman, a veteran of Reed's old battalion. She is 34 in the year 664, and her looks stopped there when her name took hold. About 198 cm, broad-shouldered, heavy-set and powerful. Light olive skin, her race's own colour. Ochre-red hair pulled back into a short tail. Yellow-hazel eyes. Two small lower tusk tips show outside her lips. A notch is missing from the top of her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us), from squeezing through a hedge as a child. She carries a long-hafted battle axe and a leather pouch of dried nuts at her hip. No earrings, no jewellery. A warm, patient, big-sister air: she grins and cuts in on old soldiers, and crouches to speak slowly to children.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's broad, strong face with a squarish jaw; gently slanted yellow-hazel eyes with a warm, steady look; thick straight ochre-red brows; a broad nose; two small lower tusk tips poking up outside the lower lip on both sides, NOT vampire fangs; a wide mouth that grins easily; the top of the left ear notched (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Light olive skin with soft warm shadows.  Her skin is light olive with a faint greenish cast, the same pale tone as the light around her; NOT tanned, NOT brown, NOT sun-darkened.
build: 198 cm, burly and heavy-set: broad, thick shoulders and big strong arms, a solid thick waist and belly, a B-cup, wide strong hips and heavy legs.
palette: light olive, ochre red, worn leather brown, faded battalion grey-green, iron grey
casual: Her everyday clothes at the mill village: a worn issue leather jerkin, patched many times, over a faded grey-green wool tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, the old battalion's stitched mark gone pale on the left chest; brown wool trousers with one shin wrapped in an old cloth bandage; scuffed leather boots, the left one split at the toe; the leather pouch of dried nuts on a strap at her right hip. The long-hafted battle axe hangs across her back. She stands at ease, cracking a nut between thumb and fingers, with a broad closed-mouth grin.
private: Off duty at the miller's house: a loose, long-sleeved undyed linen shirt, a brown wool waistcoat left open, plain brown trousers and soft old boots, the ochre-red hair let down to the nape. She holds out a small handful of shelled nuts on her open palm, offering them, with a gentle smile.
battle: Holding the road before the shut gate, in her lost battalion's old war gear refitted to her frame: the patched issue leather jerkin worn over a grey wall-issue enchanted mail shirt whose rings glint with a faint blue-white rune line at the hem; a single heavy enchanted pauldron re-strapped on the left shoulder, the battalion's stitched mark scratched into it, one small magic crystal still lit in its socket; rune-etched steel vambraces with a scuffed glow; a grey-green scarf knotted at the throat; the nut pouch at the right hip. She grips the long-hafted battle axe in both hands and holds it across her body at chest height like a barrier, an old war crystal set at the head's collar glowing pale and a thin rune line running along the chipped edge. The feet are planted wide, the brows drawn down, the mouth set, the tusk tips showing.
formal: Leaving with the new court's march in 670, in the new dynasty's plain military style: a clean issue coat in old-copper brown with a standing collar and a single row of copper buttons done up to the throat, no gilding and no jewels, a dark leather belt, clean grey trousers tucked into new boots. The long axe hangs across her back. She stands straight with the hands at her sides, a quiet, steady look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, her broad face large and off-centre. The yellow-hazel eyes look down at the viewer as if at a child, with a soft grin that shows the tusk tips. Cold grey-blue dawn light comes from one side, with a warm orange rim of dying fire on the other. She holds up one whole shelled nut between two thick fingers toward the viewer. Foreground blur: cracked nut shells and the iron studs of a shut gate.
battle_old: Holding the road before the shut gate: the patched leather jerkin over an old chain-mail shirt, leather bracers, a grey-green scarf knotted at the throat, the nut pouch at the right hip. She grips the long-hafted battle axe in both hands and holds it across her body at chest height like a barrier. The feet are planted wide, the brows drawn down, the mouth set, the tusk tips showing.
gear: 极境｜贫｜照常｜2档｜原页写明664年凝名时在极境，按位阶底子是3档。她是里德营的老兵，营已经覆没，人在水磨村靠别人家留床养伤，家境贫，极境可减一档，所以落在2档：一套改合身的旧营附魔甲，长斧算那一件像样的。她不戴首饰，日常穿补过的发放皮甲，这些照旧保留，但没有理由判成朴素或不靠装备。新朝的旧铜甲是668年以后才发的，她这一身仍是南线旧营的东西。

name: 阿达尔伯特·埃森
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3241
who: Adalbert Essen, a human man of a minor branch of the Essen house and warden of the Twin Wells section of the wall. He is 39 in the year 664, and his looks stopped there. 182 cm, long-limbed and thick in the shoulders. Sand-gold hair combed straight back. Grey-blue eyes that look first at a person's eyes, then at their hands. His nose was broken once and has a slight bump on the bridge. The first joint of his right index finger bends outward. His coat is always neat, but the top collar button is left open because of a childhood throat injury. No jewellery, no rings, no glasses. A quiet, careful, dutiful air: he says 'I'll remember it' and writes it down.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's lean, serious face in his late thirties, with faint lines at the eyes; level, attentive grey-blue eyes; straight sand-gold brows; a straight nose with a slight bump where it was broken; a firm closed mouth; clean-shaven.
build: 182 cm, long-limbed, with thick, strong archer's shoulders and back and a lean waist.
palette: sand gold, slate grey-blue, iron grey, deep blue wool, white
casual: His everyday clothes as section warden: a neat deep-blue wool long coat that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves. Every button is done up except the top collar button, which is left open. A small iron shield badge, the Essen crest, is pinned on the left chest. A plain white shirt collar shows at the throat. Dark grey trousers, polished black boots, and a leather belt with a small ring of keys. He holds a little wooden toy boat with a folded paper sail in his right hand, the crooked index finger visible, and has a faintly shy look.
private: In his own rooms: a white shirt with the collar open and the sleeves rolled up, a grey wool waistcoat, dark trousers and soft house boots. He holds a long letter with half its lines crossed out in one hand and a quill in the other, frowning at it.
battle: On the wall through the night, in an Essen branch officer's wall harness: a grey-blue wool garrison coat over a fine shirt of enchanted wall mail, the collar still left open, thin blue-white rune lines running down the mail's edges; plain ungilded steel pauldrons from the wall armoury; on the left forearm an enchanted steel archer's bracer bearing the small iron-shield crest, a magic crystal set in it glowing blue-white; a leather finger tab on the right hand; a quiver crammed with arrows at the right hip, its rim rune-lit. He holds a tall, plain yew longbow in his left hand with an arrow nocked and drawn to the cheek. The shoulders perfectly level, the eyes narrowed and fixed.
formal: In the Essen family's old style: a deep-blue wool frock coat with silver buttons and the top collar button still open, a white shirt, a grey sash, white gloves with a small iron shield embroidered at each cuff, and black boots. He stands straight with the hands behind his back, polite and reserved.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre. The grey-blue eyes look steadily at the viewer, the mouth closed, calm and tired. Cold, pale-blue rainy dawn light comes from one side, and a warm orange glow of distant fire falls on the other cheek. Foreground blur: the bent fletchings of spent arrows and a small wooden boat with a paper sail.
battle_old: On the wall through the night: a grey-blue wool garrison coat over a chain-mail shirt with the collar still left open, a leather bracer on the left forearm, a leather finger tab on the right hand, and a quiver crammed with arrows at the right hip. He holds a tall, plain yew longbow in his left hand with an arrow nocked and drawn to the cheek. The shoulders are perfectly level and the eyes narrowed and fixed.
gear: 极境（估）｜中｜照常｜3档｜他能凝名，又守一段墙，估作极境，定第三档。埃森旁支的家底中等，不加档。为人谨慎，不戴首饰，所以装备成套但朴实，招牌是刻着家纹的那只附魔护臂。

name: 西尔维奥
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3241
who: Silvio, a crimson-feast blood demon born in the First Pit mine. He is a chained miner who gives only his camp and seat, never a family name. About 40 in the year 720 but looking in his mid-twenties, like most grown demons. 187 cm, tall and lean, with thin shoulders and ropy muscle running down the back. Black hair with a dark red sheen, shaggy and uneven. Deep violet eyes. Two slightly long canine teeth. Fair skin. A notch is missing from his right ear (on the viewer's left when he faces us). A pale white shackle scar circles his left ankle. He keeps a small filed iron figure of a long-eared beast with one ear longer than the other. No jewellery. An honest, earnest, wary air.
palette: black with a dark red sheen, deep violet, rust red, mine-dust grey, white-hot
casual: His mine clothes: a ragged coarse sackcloth tunic with the sleeves torn off at different lengths, tied at the waist with a strip of rope; patched dark linen trousers rolled up above the ankles; low, worn leather boots with the laces left loose and trailing, so the white scar on the left ankle shows. He holds the little filed iron long-eared beast out on his palm to show it, with a shy, earnest look.
private: Above ground after the stone fell: a plain long-sleeved undyed linen shirt a little too big for him, dark trousers, and the same loosely laced boots. He holds the iron beast in one hand and a small file in the other, filing one ear even, absorbed, with a faint smile.
battle: Lifting the chain, in what he tore off the pit guards: a sleeveless dark leather jerkin with a few scavenged black leather plates stitched on, their blood-script runes glowing dull red, over a ragged shirt; a single dented guard's pauldron lashed to one shoulder with rope; bloody rag strips wound round both palms, an old iron shackle cuff on the right wrist reused as a bracer; the boot laces now pulled tight and knotted. He grips a short, heavy iron mining chain in both hands, a lump of iron weight on its end, and swings it back over one shoulder; the links are smeared with his blood and glow red-hot along the iron. The knees bent, the eyes fierce, the mouth tight.
formal: When the pit first sang his name: a clean dark grey long coat that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves, a deep red cloth knotted at the throat, dark trousers, and boots laced neatly. He holds half of a broken iron chain ring in one hand and stands straight, solemn and a little embarrassed.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre. The deep violet eyes look at the viewer, the mouth closed, earnest and tense. Hard white-hot light falls from above and one side like stone breaking into glowing rain, and the shadows are tinted deep red. Foreground blur: flying white-hot stone shards and a few swinging iron chain links.
battle_old: Lifting the chain: a sleeveless dark leather jerkin over a ragged shirt, bloody rag strips wound round both palms, and the boot laces now pulled tight and knotted. He grips a short, heavy iron mining chain in both hands, with a lump of iron weight on its end, and swings it back over one shoulder. The links are smeared with his blood and glow red-hot along the iron. The knees are bent, the eyes fierce, the mouth tight.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜照常｜1档｜坑里的锁奴，凝名前估作灵格。家境最差，低位阶时要减一档，只能在破衣裳外头挂几件从守卫身上扒下来的东西。他是西边的人，符文用血书的红光。

name: 塞莱斯廷·芬德尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3467
who: Celestin Fendel, a human man. He was born a reed-shack child, was taken in by an old-order monastery on the southern wall, and was lent out as a hunter to track people. 30 in the year 662. About 178 cm, narrow-shouldered, slim-waisted and wiry. Pale ash-blond hair the colour of reed plumes, shaved short on both sides and longer on top. Pale water-green eyes that look first at people's hands. A thin whip scar runs across his left cheek (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Both wrists are wrapped round with a coil of thorned white bramble. He fights left-handed with the sword. No jewellery, no badge. A flat, calculating, guarded air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's narrow, sharp-boned face of thirty; narrow, watchful pale water-green eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; thin lips that rarely smile; one thin pale whip scar across the left cheek (on the viewer's right when he faces us); clean-shaven.
build: about 178 cm, narrow shoulders, a slim waist, a wiry, light build.
palette: reed-plume ash blond, pale water green, plain grey, bone-white bramble, dried-blood brown
casual: His hunting clothes: a plain grey wool surcoat with no crest or badge, belted at the waist, over a dark grey long-sleeved tunic; grey-brown trousers and worn, mud-caked knee-high boots; the coils of thorned white bramble round both wrists. A plain straight sword in its scabbard hangs on his right hip, worn for a left-handed draw. His left hand rests on the hilt and his eyes are level.
private: Off the road: the surcoat off, a coarse grey long-sleeved shirt with the cuffs pushed back, the bramble coils at the wrists, plain trousers and soft boots. He holds a heel of dark bread in one hand and turns his empty left hand over, studying it, with an unreadable look.
battle: Ready to bind, in a hunter's kit the monastery and the Essen steward paid for, kept plain: the crestless grey surcoat belted tight over a light grey steel half-cuirass and a fitted shirt of fine enchanted mail, a faint blue-white rune line along the hems and plate edges, no badge, no ornament; plain steel vambraces and fingerless leather gloves. The bramble at his wrists has grown out, and thorned white tendrils trail from it and curl in the air with a faint white glow. He holds a plain straight double-edged sword in his left hand, NOT a curved sword, point low and forward, with the right hand open and raised. He stands light on the toes, with cold, calm eyes.
formal: In the monastery's dress for taking a vow: a long plain grey robe that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves and a white cord belt, the bramble coils at the wrists. He stands straight with the hands folded in front and the eyes lowered.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre. The water-green eyes look just past the viewer, at the viewer's hands, the mouth closed, the cheek scar clear. Cold grey morning light comes from one side, and the shadows are tinted pale green. He raises his left hand near his face, the white bramble thorns pricking the wrist with a bead of blood. Foreground blur: white bramble thorns and drifting snowflakes.
battle_old: Ready to bind: the grey surcoat belted tight over a light chain-mail shirt and fingerless leather gloves. The bramble at his wrists has grown out, and thorned white tendrils trail from it and curl in the air. He holds a plain straight double-edged sword in his left hand, NOT a curved sword, point low and forward, with the right hand open and raised. He stands light on the toes, with cold, calm eyes.
gear: 极境（LVL 112，662年；664年到英雄）｜贫｜朴素｜2档｜662年时是极境，但出身苇棚区，装备是修院和埃森管家出钱配的，减一档。修院的猎人不挂徽记，所以只穿一套合身的好甲，不加任何装饰。

name: 珂杜拉·珀尔滕
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3492
who: Cordula Pölten, a human woman, gate warden of the Wild Goose Palisade section of the wall for the Essen house. 46 in the year 661. About 168 cm, upright, sturdy and square-shouldered. Crow-black hair with a blue sheen, in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head. Grey-blue eyes, the left a shade deeper than the right. From 663 her right palm bears a burned-in iron shield brand of eleven strokes. She keeps it under a deerskin glove worn on the right hand only, and takes the glove off only when teaching at night. No jewellery. A blunt, exact, unbending air: she counts heads before she speaks.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's firm, plain face in her mid-forties, with fine lines at the eyes and mouth corners; grey-blue eyes, the left one a shade deeper than the right (the deeper one on the viewer's right when she faces us); straight dark brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth.
build: about 168 cm, sturdy and square-shouldered, a straight back, a moderate bust and a solid waist.
palette: crow black with a blue sheen, slate grey-blue, iron grey, deerskin tan, white stone
casual: Her gate warden's dress: a long iron-grey wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves and a small iron shield badge of the Essen house on the left chest. A broad leather belt carries a heavy ring of iron gate keys at the left hip. A dark grey wool skirt to the ankles and sturdy black boots. A deerskin glove covers the right hand only; the left hand is bare. She stands straight with the gloved hand closed at her side and a level, counting look.
private: In her rooms at night: a long-sleeved dark blue wool dress with a high collar, a grey knitted shawl, the braid still coiled, the right glove off. She looks down at the iron shield brand on her bare right palm, the left hand cupped beneath it.
battle: Raising the gate ward, in the warden's war kit of the new dynasty: over the iron-grey coat buttoned to the throat a plain old-copper breastplate and gorget with engraved law lines holding a warm amber glow, no gilding; a short grey cape over copper-plated shoulders; copper vambrace on the left forearm with a salvaged war crystal set in it; the heavy key ring on the belt, each key faintly rune-lit. She holds her bare right palm out flat in front of her, the eleven-stroke iron shield brand glowing pale white and faint white runes lifting from it into the shape of a hovering shield. The left hand at her side, the feet set, the face stern.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-ward outfit: braced and stern, the feet set, the bare right palm held out flat with its brand glowing faintly white, the left hand at her side; she holds no weapon.
formal: For an audience with the Essen house: a deep-blue wool long coat with silver buttons, a white collar, a long dark grey skirt, and white gloves with a small iron shield embroidered at each cuff, the braid pinned neatly. She stands at attention.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, her face large and off-centre. The unequal grey-blue eyes look straight at the viewer, the mouth closed, stern and tired. Cold blue snow-night light comes from one side, and the shadows are tinted deep slate blue. Her raised bare right palm, near her face, gives off a faint white glow from the iron shield brand. Foreground blur: falling snow and the pale edge of a white stone gate.
battle_old: Raising the gate ward: the iron-grey coat buttoned to the throat, a short grey cape over the shoulders, the key ring on the belt. She holds her bare right palm out flat in front of her, the eleven-stroke iron shield brand glowing pale white and faint white runes lifting from it. The left hand is at her side, the feet set, the face stern.
gear: 极境（LVL 98）｜世家｜照常｜3档｜极境定第三档。珀尔滕家世代替埃森掌门，家境到了极境只差一截。她手里没有兵器，招牌是那串带符文光的钥匙和掌心的烙印。这一档和样张对得上，照样张交回。

name: 奥多里希·哈斯珀
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3518
who: Odorich Hasper, a human man, steward of the Essen house. 52 in the year 665. About 175 cm, thin, narrow and neat. Grey-white hair combed flat and smooth. Amber eyes. On the little finger of his left hand he wears an iron ring whose crest has been worn smooth. At his waist hangs the Essen master key on a chain, its bow shaped as an iron shield. No other jewellery, no glasses. A soft-spoken, polite, ledger-minded air: he speaks only of 'the house' and never names its head.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, smooth older man's face of fifty-two, with fine lines at the eyes and two lines beside the mouth; polite, half-lowered amber eyes; thin grey brows; a narrow nose; a thin closed mouth with a faint courteous smile; clean-shaven.
build: about 175 cm, thin and narrow-shouldered, upright.
palette: grey white, amber, iron grey, deep blue, black
casual: His steward's clothes: a black wool long coat that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves, over a deep-blue waistcoat and a white shirt with a plain black neckcloth; dark grey trousers and polished black shoes. The iron master key hangs on its chain at the left hip. He holds a folded, unsigned bounty notice in his right hand, the left hand with the iron ring resting at his waist, and wears a mild, courteous smile.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved grey wool house coat buttoned up, a plain white shirt, dark trousers and soft black slippers, the master key still on its chain at the hip. He holds a small leather account book and a pencil, adding up figures.
battle: On a night raid with riders who carry no banner: a long black riding cloak over the black coat, the hood down, its dark lining stitched with a ward thread that glows faint blue-white along the hem and edges; black leather riding gloves, the iron ring worn over the left glove; no armour at all. He carries no sword. He holds the iron master key up in his right hand, its shield-shaped bow glowing faintly white, with the left hand open at his side. Upright and composed, the feet set.
battle_pose: 3) the night-ride outfit: upright and composed, the feet set, one hand holding up the iron master key with its shield-shaped bow glowing faintly; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: In the Essen house's livery for a great dinner: a long black wool coat with silver buttons, an iron-grey waistcoat embroidered with a small iron shield, a white cravat, white gloves, black trousers and polished shoes, the master key on a silver chain at the hip. He stands with the hands folded in front and the head slightly bowed.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre. The amber eyes look at the viewer with a polite, half-lowered gaze and a faint courteous smile, the mouth closed. Warm candle-amber light comes from one side, with cold iron-grey shadows. He holds the shield-bowed master key up near his face. Foreground blur: a worn, smooth silver coin and the torn corner of a nailed-up paper notice.
battle_old: On a night raid with riders who carry no banner: a long black riding cloak over the black coat, with the hood down, and black leather riding gloves, the iron ring worn over the left glove. He carries no sword. He holds the iron master key up in his right hand, its shield-shaped bow glowing faintly white, with the left hand open at his side.
gear: 灵格（估）｜富｜不打仗｜1档｜管家自己不拿剑，本事全在总钥上，位阶是估的。埃森家有钱，但他不上阵，不该硬给他穿甲，只给一件缝了护身线的骑行斗篷。

name: 耶尔格
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3518
who: Jerg, a human man, captain of the Broken Mast company, river mercenaries who started out scuttling boats on the Gold Kite River. 41 in the year 665. About 185 cm, broad-chested with strong arms. Wheat-gold hair tied back in a short tail, and a full wheat-gold beard braided into two plaits. Bright cornflower-blue eyes, and cheeks reddened by the river wind. In his left ear he wears three rings hammered from ship nails (on the viewer's right when he faces us). His weapon is a chained mast hook. No other jewellery. A loud, easy-going, businesslike air; he loses and pays up without a grudge.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, rugged man's face of forty-one, with crow's feet at the eyes and cheeks reddened by the river wind; bright cornflower-blue eyes; thick wheat-gold brows; a large straight nose; a full wheat-gold beard braided into two plaits that hang below the chin; a wide grin; three ship-nail rings in the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us).
build: about 185 cm, broad-chested and thick-armed, a sturdy waist.
palette: wheat gold, cornflower blue, tarred black, river grey-green, rust
casual: His company clothes: a worn tarred-canvas short coat over a leather vest, with the company badge, a broken ship's mast stitched in white on black, sewn on the left chest; a dark linen shirt; a coil of hemp rope slung across the body; loose canvas trousers tucked into high waxed boots. He leans on the pole of the chained mast hook, a long iron hook whose heavy chain is wrapped round the pole, with a broad grin.
private: Ashore: an untucked, loose wool shirt in faded river green with the sleeves pushed up, rope braces, canvas trousers and old boots. He holds a wooden tankard in one hand and counts silver coins on the other palm, laughing.
battle: Leading a boarding, in his company's salvaged river kit: over the tarred coat an old enchanted wall half-plate repainted black with the white broken-mast badge, its rune lines glowing blue-white and one lit crystal at the breastbone; a dented enchanted iron cap with a rune band round the brow; brass-jointed vambraces salvaged from a clockwork war machine; a coil of hemp rope across the body. He swings the chained mast hook, the heavy iron hook flying out on its chain from one hand while the chain wraps round the other forearm, rune-lit iron rings flaring along the links. The feet braced wide, the beard plaits flying, the grin fierce.
formal: At the company muster under its flag: a long dark-blue wool coat with brass buttons, the broken-mast badge on the left chest, a clean white shirt, a red sash and polished boots, the beard plaits tied with new red cord. He stands with arms folded and a proud grin.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre. The cornflower-blue eyes look at the viewer with a wolfish grin, and the three nail rings catch the light. Pale grey-green river-mist light comes from one side, warm torch orange from the other. Foreground blur: drifting river mist, a swinging iron chain and the snapped tip of a hook.
battle_old: Leading a boarding: a boiled-leather cuirass over the tarred coat, a dented iron cap and leather bracers. He swings the chained mast hook, the heavy iron hook flying out on its chain from one hand while the chain wraps round the other forearm. The feet are braced wide, the beard plaits flying, the grin fierce.
gear: 极境（LVL 91）｜中｜照常｜3档｜极境定第三档。断桅团八十来人，家底中等，靠遗迹捡来的东西凑成一身，重新漆上团徽。招牌是那根带链的桅钩。

name: 赛弗里德·克莱门斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3601
who: Seyfried Clemens, a human man, head of the Clemens house, the oldest of the fourteen upper-city families and descended from the White Kite royal line. 53 in the year 668. About 180 cm, tall, upright and lean. Silver-white hair combed back smooth and flat. A high, hooked nose like a kite's beak. Grey-blue eyes that look first at people's hands. He wears white gloves with the family crest embroidered at the cuffs, and carries Kite's Beak, a long rune-engraved spell-gun. No rings, no other jewellery, no glasses. A slow, courteous, formal air, as if reading aloud from a family register.
